cost.buy_cost: already embedded in frozen fill_price, do not double count
cost.reference_module: predict/trading/backtest-cost-model.js @ Entry HEAD; research override reconciled to frozen Entry5bps, not generic default preset

counter_reset: positive prediction, missing raw minute, AM/PM phase boundary
fill: next available eligible regular raw open at start>=intent; if none, scheduled same-session closing-auction close
forced_session_close: preplanned closing-auction liquidation, closing source missing=>UNRESOLVED, never last-observed-close substitution

hard1.assumption: OHLC standing stop proxy; raw line is not a guaranteed net -1% loss; unseen gaps/touches remain unobserved
hard1.baseline_pending_market_fill_at_same_ope: executes first, intrabar stop does not override it
hard1.intrabar_high_low_order: unknown; stop-bar High excluded from strictly-later later-winner audit
hard1.monitor: observed eligible regular bars only, including Entry fill bar;540/750 mixed openings and AM/PM terminal auctions excluded

intent: earliest second consecutive prediction<=0 post Entry fill; lock intent
state_machine: POSITION_OPEN -> HOLD/EXIT_INTENT -> SELL_FILL -> CLOSED; closed arms stop decisions; no reentry
